column1: Skill Framing Verbs — Resume / CV Bullet Builder

Same skill, same neutral fact — framed with an Agentic verb or a Communal verb. Each verb is listed in both -ed (past, for completed achievements) and -ing (present, for current roles or ongoing responsibilities) form. Use whichever tense and framing matches the role and tone you want.
